messages:
Aisha (AE): Ripcord wants a 3-week POC to replace CompetitorX with Redwood for their customer chat. Key asks: prompt/response parity, streaming + function calls, cost delta, and security questionnaire. Need SE + SRE.

Ben (SE): I can lead the POC. Ask them for ~200 sample requests + expected outputs. Need to know streaming format and function-call shape.

Dana (Presales): They stream chunked lines and use heavy function-calling. System prompt pinned per session. They'll share sanitized logs after NDA.

Chao (SRE): Security checklist: SAML/SCIM, IP allowlist, KMS keys, SOC2 evidence, cert pinning. Hosted covers IP allowlist and logs; client certs / VPC peering => Dedicated/Private.

Ben (SE): Plan: build a small adapter that maps CompetitorX request shape (passages, func_call) -> Redwood chat schema (messages, functions). Rewrap streaming deltas into their line-delimited frames. Watch function args encoding and stop-sequence behavior.

Ben (SE): Quick pseudo mapping:
POST /competitorx/generate {passages, func_call} -> POST /v1/chat/completions {messages, functions, function_call}
Streaming: map Redwood delta -> competitor chunk frames.

Chao (SRE): Billing note: CompetitorX historically billed response tokens only. Redwood bills prompt+completion. Rough estimate: redwood_cost ≈ competitor_response_cost * 1.08 + small per-call overhead. Recommend 48-72h side-by-side capture for accuracy.

Dana (Presales): They'll send a ~30–40 page security questionnaire and ask about DPA, data residency, SSO. I'll own the questionnaire and coordinate with Legal.

infra-bot: env created: ripcord-poc-staging. Upload path: s3://redwood-pocs/ripcord-staging/. Ephemeral keys issued.

Aisha (AE): Owners: Ben -> POC lead & eval harness; Chao -> infra + allowlist; Dana -> security questionnaire & SSO; Aisha -> NDA + customer coord. Kickoff Monday, 3-week target.

Ben (SE): I'll push a smoke script and runbook to the S3 bucket and prototype the shim within 24h. Example smoke curl (streaming): curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."}],"stream":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions

Chao (SRE): Staging IPs for allowlist: 34.198.123.45, 34.198.123.46. If they require cert pinning we escalate to Private.

LegalBot: NDA required before upload of any customer data. Legal to review DPA/subprocessor items.

Aisha (AE): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll send NDA and request sanitized dataset. Post blockers here before kickoff.
